article.title: League Classic 26.18 · Summary
article.author: App editorial team
article.body:
Editorial summary of Riot Games' 26.18 League Classic notes. Five returning champions join Classic: Fiora, Galio, Poppy, Shyvana and Xin Zhao. The patch also adjusts Anivia, Gangplank, Heimerdinger, Kayle, Malzahar, Nasus and Warwick.

The first Council vote supports restoring all three proposed items, adding modern jungle timers, and placing a turtle in the upper river and a duck in the lower river. These decisions are planned for a future patch.

Classic chromas are being combined with their associated base skins. Players who bought only a Classic chroma will receive its base skin. Baron Rammus is planned to leave the store in 26.20. The patch also fixes ability issues affecting Teemo, Akali, Skarner and Nidalee.

This is a summary. Open the official Riot Games notes for the complete changes, exact values and ability details.

council.title: Council · First vote results
decisions: Restore Zz'Rot Portal, Cloak and Dagger, and Moonflair Spellblade
Add modern jungle timers visible on the minimap
Add a turtle to the upper river and a duck to the lower river

questions.question: How does the length of a game feel?
At what length does a game feel too long?
Which items should return in Classic? An item must pass 50% of the vote, including votes for all three.
Should Classic add jungle timers? If the first two options together pass 50%, the more popular one wins.
options: Yes, always show modern timers on the minimap
Yes, but only while the scoreboard is open

questions.question: Should base gates remain in the game? They were added in Season 5 to help defending teams protect their base.
How much do current games snowball?
Do ward trinkets improve Classic gameplay?
options: No, I do not like them

questions.question: Which two river critters should be added? The first is for the upper river, the second for the lower river.

article.title: リーグ クラシック 26.18 · 要約
article.author: アプリ編集部
article.body:
Riot Gamesのパッチ26.18に含まれるリーグ クラシックの要約です。フィオラ、ガリオ、ポッピー、シヴァーナ、シン・ジャオの5人がクラシックに登場します。アニビア、ガングプランク、ハイマーディンガー、ケイル、マルザハール、ナサス、ワーウィックにもバランス調整があります。

第1回カウンシル投票では、提案された3つのアイテムすべての復活、最新のジャングルタイマーの追加、上側の川にカメ・下側の川にアヒルを追加する案が支持されました。これらの変更は今後のパッチで実装予定です。

クラシックスキンのクロマは対応するベーススキンに統合されます。クロマだけを購入したプレイヤーにはベーススキンが配布されます。バロン ラムスは26.20で販売終了予定です。ティーモ、アカリ、スカーナー、ニダリーのスキルに関する不具合も修正されます。

これは要約です。正確な数値とスキルの詳細を含む変更内容は、Riot Gamesの公式パッチノートをご覧ください。
